metadata.title: HOOD Stock Drops Overnight Amid Bitcoin Weakness: Robinhood Reports 28.9M Funded Customers In October

content.text:
-
Total platform assets declined 3% from September to $383 billion, but were up 12% year-over-year.
-
Meanwhile, net deposits were $15.1 billion, a 46% annualized growth rate relative to September.
-
On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around HOOD stock was 'bearish' at the time of writing, though many users pointed to the positive catalysts for the company.
Shares of Robinhood Markets Inc. (HOOD) slumped more than 2% in the overnight session late on Thursday as a slide in Bitcoin prices weighed on the stock, though its October metrics came in strong.
Bitcoin (BTC) prices dropped to $68,399.67 at the time of writing, the lowest level since August.
Robinhood's October Metrics Come In Strong
Earlier on Thursday, Robinhood said its funded customers at the end of October were 28.9 million, up about 130,000 from September and around 1.8 million year-over-year.
Total platform assets declined 3% from September to $383 billion, but were up 12% year-over-year. Meanwhile, net deposits were $15.1 billion, a 46% annualized growth rate relative to September.
Equity Notional Trading Volumes were $325 billion, up 2% year-over-year, with average daily volumes at $14.8 billion. Options Contracts Traded were at 289 million, up 8% year-over-year. Event Contracts Traded were 5.9 billion, up 136% year-over-year.
However, Crypto Notional Trading Volumes clocked in at $17 billion, down 48% year-over-year, including Robinhood App Notional Trading Volumes of $6.8 billion and Bitstamp Notional Trading Volumes of $10.2 billion.
What's Retail Saying About HOOD Stock?
On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around HOOD stock was 'bearish' at the time of writing, although many users pointed to the positive catalysts for the company.
One user said, "$HOOD October numbers: crypto volume down 48% y/y to ~$17B, but margin balances up 39% to ~$23B and another ~$15B of net deposits. Stock ~$84, down ~1%. Customers are still putting money in imo. Bullish."
Another user said, "$HOOD $23B margin balances: a new income signal."
However, one user noted, "$HOOD bitcoin has fallen below 70,000.... it's at 69,000. dragging robinhood down."
HOOD stock is down 28% in 2026.
